title: Jesus Goes to Egypt! 🐫 The Holy Family's Secret Journey | Bible Story for Kids | Sunday School
desc:
Jesus came to Egypt! 🐫🇪🇬 In this Bible story for kids, an angel warns Joseph in a dream, and the Holy Family escapes at night across the desert to Egypt. Miss Rania's class builds a blanket tent and tiptoes on their own secret journey, and we learn that God watches over us every day and every night.

📖 Memory verse: "The Lord is your keeper." (Psalm 121:5)
🎯 Lesson: God watches over us. When we feel scared, we pray and trust Him, just like Mary and Joseph.
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.
